question: The growing voice box in boys can be seen as a protruding part of the throat called _______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Adam's apple**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The Adam's apple** is a visible protrusion in the throat caused by the thyroid cartilage, which is larger in males due to hormonal differences during puberty.
 
• The Adam's apple is not present in females or pre-pubescent males.
 
• The term "gullet" refers to the esophagus, which is the muscular tube that connects the throat to the stomach.
 
• "Corn" likely refers to the vegetable, which is not related to the topic at hand.
 
• "Adrenalin" is a hormone that is produced by the adrenal glands and is involved in the body's "fight or flight" response, but it is not related to the Adam's apple.

 [IMAGE: https://i0.wp.com/images-prod.healthline.com/hlcmsresource/images/4632-adams-apple-1296x728-body.jpg?w=1155&h=1528] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **The voice box, or larynx, **is a vital organ in the body that serves a number of purposes. It is situated in the neck.
 
• The larynx is involved in breathing, producing voice, and swallowing.
 
• The vocal cords vibrate in response to air passing through them, producing sound waves in the mouth, nose, and throat.
